# Research notes

- One note per paper, written with skill `paper-notes`: citation verified before writing, sections and tags as in `.agents/skills/paper-notes/reference.md`.
- Notes hold what the paper says and how it relates to the project; tooling, config keys and plans go to `research/AGENTS.md` or `plans/`.
- No PDFs, copied result tables or citations from memory.
- Every note is linked from its folder note; `make vault-check` passes before hand-off.
